node: Leading-edge foundry, advanced packaging, and lithography
summary: Expanded US-listed universe around the AI advanced foundry/packaging/lithography chokepoint with emphasis on second-order beneficiaries: OSAT capacity, advanced-packaging metrology/inspection, ultra-clean materials, lithography/metrology subsystems, and electronics/packaging process tools. This is research support only, not a trading recommendation. The strongest direct node relations in this pass are Amkor and ASE Technology for outsourced advanced packaging/test; Onto and KLA-like process-control vendors appear underappreciated because AI chiplet/HBM packaging raises inspection and metrology intensity; Entegris and MKS are second-order suppliers tied to purity, EUV handling, lithography/metrology subsystems, PCB/substrate and packaging process needs.
